subject: Important Update: Your Flight Itinerary Changes
body: Dear Passenger, We regret to inform you that there have been some changes to your upcoming flight itinerary. Your departure time has been rescheduled to accommodate unexpected maintenance. Please review the updated details attached to this email. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact our customer service team. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels!
